positioning: A lightweight analytics and content-strategy toolkit that lets video production agencies prove and replicate organic growth outcomes for B2B clients without paid spend.
coreFeatures: YouTube and social metrics ingestion that plots monthly view curves and highlights organic vs. paid contribution
Reusable content-strategy templates (hooks, shot lists, briefs) that prospects can fork and adapt per client
Video SEO audit script that scores existing client videos against top-performing formats and surfaces quick wins
differentiators: Outcome-first dashboard that visualizes 30x-style growth curves as a sales asset for agencies
Open, forkable strategy templates that shorten onboarding versus bespoke consulting
No-ad-spend framing that aligns with founders skeptical of paid acquisition
mvpBuildPlan: Build a minimal YouTube Data API ingestion script that stores monthly views per channel and renders a simple growth-curve chart
Package 3-5 content-strategy templates (hook bank, shot list, brief doc) into a public repo prospects can clone
Write a CLI video SEO audit that checks title, description, tags, and thumbnail against a heuristic rubric and outputs a score
risks: Public YouTube/social APIs have rate limits and ToS constraints that may limit scale
Forkable templates may be copied by competitors, eroding differentiation
Metrics-only proof may not generalize across industries beyond the showcased case study
valueProposition: Grow monthly views 30x (3.9K to 118K) in 8 months with zero ad spend through strategic video production and content strategy
